neighbours.label: a required value of a physical quantity in a worked problem ('its speed must be ...')
fire: Its speed must be 0.75c, so that the clock runs slow.
The car's speed must be 60 km/h to stop in time.
The rock's velocity must be 12 m/s when it lands.
The acceleration must be 3 m/s² for the block to slide.
The ball's speed must be 20 m/s at the top of the arc.
The frequency must be 50 Hz so that the motor runs smoothly.
The voltage must be 5 V for the sensor to work.
The wavelength must be 500 nm, so that the film appears green.
quiet: The clock runs slow near a massive star.
The car's speed was shown on a dial by the wheel.
The rock's velocity was measured with a radar gun.
The block slides along the table and stops.
The ball rose to the top of the arc and fell.
The motor runs smoothly and hums quietly.
The sensor is wired to a small power supply.
The film appears green in ordinary daylight.

notes: The pole's top examples are spread over worked maths and physics; ' is', ',' and digits all peak. This label is the narrowest thing probes suggested.
